evals.prompt: Reps keep sandbagging. Forecast is always ±30%. How do we fix the system?
evals.expected_output: Should focus on process inspection over optimism. Should recommend multiple forecasting lenses, segmented conversion rates, commit/best-case discipline, and accuracy measurement. Should not pretend a single CRM probability field is enough.
assertions: Treats forecast as process quality not wishful thinking
Addresses commit categories or inspection cadence
Defines how to measure forecast accuracy
